# The obee process dies during the implement step. The next obee run finishes the same run
# and does not repeat the plan step.
! exec obee run 7 &
waitfile started
kill -KILL
wait

exec obee status
stdout '^item-7-r1\trunning$'

exec obee run 7
stdout 'item 7 finished after 0 fix rounds'

exec obee status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone$'
! stdout 'item-7-r2'

grep -count=1 '^plan 0 true a ' calls.log
grep -count=2 '^implement 0 true a ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^review 0 true a ' calls.log

cmp events.log expected-events.log

-- hang --
implement
-- verdicts --
approve
-- expected-events.log --
claim 7
ready 7
release 7
